title: gbuild configuration
description: Declarative configuration schema for the gbuild system.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema file.

_securityNote.description: Security guidance: all credential fields use ${env:VAR} placeholders resolved from the environment at runtime. Never commit real secrets.

maxJobsMax.description: Hard ceiling for parallel workers (Parallel.psm1 clamp). Defaults to max(maxParallelJobs*4, 16) when omitted.

parallelMaxJobsScaleFactor.description: Scale factor for maxJobsMax = maxParallelJobs * factor (BuildConstants.ParallelMaxJobsScaleFactor).

msBuildParallelArgs.description: MSBuild parallel build arguments appended to dotnet publish (BuildConstants.MsBuildParallelArgs).

projectRootMaxDepth.description: Max directory depth for Find-ProjectRoot upward scan (BuildConstants.ProjectRootMaxDepth).

relativeDepthErrorSentinel.description: Sentinel value for relative-depth errors in SDK discovery (BuildConstants.RelativeDepthErrorSentinel).

searchMaxDepth.description: Directory recursion depth for Find-IndependentProjects csproj scan (default 3).

progressPollIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between progress updates during parallel builds

progress.description: Live build output streaming + silence heartbeat (BuildProgress.psm1 Invoke-WithLiveOutput). Applies to dotnet publish, plugin builds, SAST and container scans.

enabled.description: Master switch; when false commands run buffered and silent (CI log-friendly).

streamOutput.description: Stream child-process lines to the console as they arrive instead of buffering until exit.

throttleMs.description: Minimum gap between consecutive non-error/warning output lines (noise throttle).

elapsedIntervalSec.description: Heartbeat interval: log + EVT_STEP_PROGRESS when the child is silent this many seconds.

pollMs.description: Main-thread drain/heartbeat polling interval for Process mode.

killWaitMs.description: Bounded wait after Kill() in BuildProgress (BuildConstants.ProgressKillWaitMs).

scopedLogging.description: Scoped pipeline logging: collapse disabled-step noise into one summary line so each build only shows logs relevant to its own project type (BuildConstants.LogScopedLogging).

openOutput.description: Reveal the publish-output folder after a successful build (BuildConstants.OpenOutput). Shipped true for the interactive dev loop; never opens in CI/non-interactive runs even when true; set false to stay quiet everywhere.

affected.description: Nx-style affected-project detection (report + optional skip of unchanged projects)

enabled.description: Run the AffectedScan pipeline step (content fingerprint + git diff)

skipUnchanged.description: Drop unchanged projects from the parallel build list (report-only when false)

projectMarkers.description: Project marker file patterns for auto-detection (BuildConstants.ProjectMarkers).

shortHashLength.description: Short hash display length for cache keys (BuildConstants.ShortHashLength).

pluginHashLength.description: Plugin incremental cache hash length (BuildConstants.PluginCacheHashLength, distinct from shortHashLength).

deployChoiceArgs.description: Deploy-choice MSBuild args single-source (BuildConstants DeployChoiceArgs*; Orchestrator Get-DeployChoiceArgs).

portWaitAttempts.description: Polling attempts (PortWaitDelayMs apart) waiting for the OS to release an occupied port before build.

portWaitDelayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait between port-release polling attempts.

default.description: Default UI language. External translation files live in _Build/Locales/<locale>.json and override the built-in messages.

standalone.description: Single-file self-extracting bundle (Standalone.psm1): packages gbuild.ps1 + Modules + Locales into one .ps1 that runs anywhere without the _Build tree.

outputFile.description: Output bundle name. Absolute path, or relative to _Build (ScriptRoot).

includeConfig.description: Embed gbuild.config.json into the bundle. Disabled by default so credentials in the config never travel.

embedLocales.description: Embed Locales/*.json so the bundle is language-complete.

bundleVersion.description: Single-file bundle format version (BuildConstants.StandaloneBundleVersion), not the gbuild tool version.

publishArtifact.description: PublishArtifact pipeline step (Orchestrator $buildSteps): runs Steps/publish-artifact.ps1 to archive publish output after a successful build.

envFile.description: Optional .env file (relative to project root) loaded at startup before config secret resolution. Leave empty to rely on the automatic <ProjectRoot>/.env load.

runTestLint.description: LEGACY: superseded by build.test.enabled / build.test.lintEnabled (standalone Test/Lint pipeline steps). Used only when both canonical values are absent.

test.description: Standalone Test/Lint pipeline steps (Orchestrator $buildSteps). Applies to ALL languages via plugin dispatch. Non-blocking: missing tests/tools log a warning and never fail the build.

enabled.description: Run the 'Test' step (plugin test flow) after Build.

lintEnabled.description: Run the 'Lint' step (plugin lint flow) after Test. Default off: lint is an opt-in step (menu 'I'), matching BuildConstants.TestLintEnabled and the shipped gbuild.config.json.

processKillList.description: Extra process names to kill when clearing a locked output dir (Build.psm1). The project exe name is always included.

pluginDirs.description: Additional plugin directories (relative to ProjectRoot or absolute)

languageMap.description: Custom language detection entries (merged into built-in map)

region.description: Primary AWS region (for S3) or Azure region

modulePath.description: Path to custom provider module (for custom type)

compress.description: GZip-compress cache entries before sending to the remote store (transparent decompression on receive)

presignExpiresSeconds.description: Expiry in seconds for S3 presigned URLs (CacheProvider.New-S3SignedUrl).

ha.description: High Availability / Disaster Recovery configuration for multi-region cache replication

replicationStrategy.description: Replication mode: async (fire-and-forget), sync (wait for all), quorum (wait for N/2+1)

regions.description: Secondary regions for replication (each entry mirrors primary config structure)

failbackDelaySec.description: Delay before failing back to primary

maxStalenessSec.description: Max acceptable replication lag for reads

cacheLocal.description: Local build-cache eviction policy (LRU + age). All thresholds config-driven; no hardcode.

enabled.description: Enable LRU/age eviction of the local cache directory

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of cache entries to retain

maxAgeDays.description: Maximum age of a cache entry in days before eviction

maxSizeMb.description: Maximum total local cache size in MB before eviction

menu.description: Config-driven custom menu entries (extensibility without editing core).

customEntries.description: User-defined menu items merged into the interactive build menu.

key.description: Single-character/menu key shown to the user (e.g. 'Z').

title.description: Optional uppercase title shown when selected.

handler.description: Command/function name invoked when the entry is chosen.

dotnetTypes.description: Canonical .NET project types driving menu, orchestrator dispatch and non-.NET routing (Project.psm1 Get-ProjectTypes; 'Unknown' is appended automatically).

moduleMap.description: Menu choice -> module names lazy-loaded on demand (Orchestrator.psm1 Get-ModuleMapFromConfig / Import-ModuleOnDemand).

pipeline.description: Pipeline execution settings for the in-process engine in Orchestrator.psm1 (Resolve-PipelineSteps/Resolve-PipelineYamlSteps/Invoke-GuildPipeline; formerly PipelineRunner.psm1, now merged). A gbuild.pipeline.yml, when present, takes precedence over these steps.

timeoutSeconds.description: Global pipeline timeout in seconds (0 = no limit)

maxRetries.description: Default retry count per step (0 = no retry)

validate.description: Validate pipeline step definitions (both gbuild.config.json steps and gbuild.pipeline.yml) before the pipeline runs. A step with an unknown key, a missing task, a non-numeric timeout or an unparseable when: fails the build instead of being silently ignored.

file.description: Path to a YAML pipeline definition, relative to the build root unless rooted. When set, this file takes PRECEDENCE over build.pipeline.steps. With no value, gbuild.pipeline.yml is auto-discovered in ProjectRoot only (never ScriptRoot, never the current directory).

steps.description: Config-driven pipeline steps. WARNING: when non-empty this REPLACES the built-in pipeline (RegisterPlugins → ScanProject → AffectedScan → Preflight → Build). Each entry: name + script (scriptblock body receiving $ctx); optional when (bool scriptblock, false → skip + EVT_STEP_SKIPPED), retry, timeoutSeconds.

jobIsolated.description: Run this step in a background job with a HARD timeout (Invoke-PipelineStepJobAttempt): the child process is killed when timeoutSeconds elapses. Requires timeoutSeconds on the same step. The in-process path can only measure a breach after the body returns, so a hung step hangs the pipeline without this.

mode.description: How config steps combine with the built-in ones: replace (config steps only, default), merge (override same-named built-in steps in place and append new ones), or append (built-in steps first, then config steps).

checkSyntax.description: Run universal syntax check across project files

checkManifest.description: Validate project manifest files are parseable

checkAllManifests.description: Scan all manifests in project dir, not just the primary one

checkTools.description: Verify required CLI tools are installed

checkDiskSpace.description: Check free disk space meets threshold

checkModuleGraph.description: Validate the module dependency graph for missing dependencies and import cycles

requiredTools.description: CLI tools that must exist on PATH (e.g. dotnet, node, cargo, go, docker)

endpoints.description: HTTP(S) endpoints to ping during network check

languageOverrides.description: Map language name to plugin override

plugins.description: Formal plugin manifest + versioning policy (PluginSDK.psm1). Each plugin may ship a sidecar <Name>.plugin.json manifest; this section governs compatibility gates.

enabled.description: Master switch for versioned plugin loading. When false, no versioned plugins load.

strictApiCheck.description: When true, plugin apiVersion MAJOR+MINOR must match the SDK exactly. When false, any plugin apiVersion <= SDK apiVersion is accepted.

allowPrerelease.description: Allow prerelease plugin versions (e.g. 1.2.0-beta.1). Blocked by default for build reproducibility.

requireManifest.description: When true, plugins WITHOUT a sidecar manifest file are rejected instead of synthesized from Get-PluginInfo.

disabled.description: Plugin names that must never load (block-list wins over allowList).

allowList.description: When non-empty, ONLY listed plugin names may load.

cluster.description: Multi-cluster orchestration (ClusterOrchestrator.psm1): Kubernetes operator integration, distributed scheduling, and leader-election HA.

operator.description: gbuild Kubernetes operator installation. install=true invokes Install-GBuildOperator (previously reachable only via a PipelineContext key nothing ever set).

install.description: Install the gbuild operator and its CRDs into the cluster.

namespace.description: Namespace the operator is installed into.

tag.description: Operator image tag. ClusterOrchestrator.psm1 Install-GBuildOperator hard-fails without a tag, so operator.install=true was unsatisfiable while this key was absent from the schema (build.cluster is additionalProperties:false).

version.description: Operator image version. Same fail-closed precondition as tag.

submit.description: Kubernetes job submission. enabled=true builds a ClusterBuildSpec from the resolved project and submits it (Submit-ClusterBuild -> Get-ClusterBuildStatus -> Wait-ClusterBuild).

enabled.description: Submit the current build as a Kubernetes Job.

builderImage.description: Builder image for the submitted Job. Must be an explicit tag or @sha256: digest; ':latest' is rejected by Submit-ClusterBuild.

command.description: Command executed inside the Job container.

stopLeaderElection.description: Stop the coordinator leader-election background job and release the lease.

leaseName.description: Kubernetes Lease name for leader election

kubeconfig.description: Path to kubeconfig file (or use KUBECONFIG env)

maxConcurrent.description: Max concurrent builds on this cluster

maxConcurrentPerCluster.description: Default max concurrent builds per cluster

job.description: Per-build Kubernetes Job sizing and target namespace. Replaces the former build.cluster.scheduling.resourceCpu/resourceMemory, which were resolved into the runtime config and then discarded while the submit manifest carried its own hardcoded values.

requestCpu.description: Container CPU request for submitted build Jobs

requestMemory.description: Container memory request for submitted build Jobs

limitCpu.description: Container CPU limit for submitted build Jobs

limitMemory.description: Container memory limit for submitted build Jobs

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Seconds a finished Job is retained before the cluster reaps it

namespace.description: Namespace submitted Jobs land in when the build spec does not override it

projectTypeActions.description: Per-project-type dotnet publish args (Build.psm1 Get-ProjectTypeActions). Keys: MAUI/Web/WinForms/WPF/Console/WinExe/BlazorWasm/Library. Each entry: android/ios/windows/nonWindows/default (string[] with ${rid} placeholder) or command+args (Library).

cacheArtifactPatterns.description: OutputSubDir -> artifact glob patterns with ${exeBaseName} placeholder (Build.psm1 Get-CacheArtifactPatterns).

targetCatalog.description: Optional custom target catalog overriding the auto-derived build choices (Orchestrator.psm1 Get-TargetCatalog / Get-BuildTargetChoices) and the failure-is-fatal set (Orchestrator.psm1 Get-FatalActionChoices).

fatalChoices.description: Menu choices whose non-throwing failure must abort the run (default: the RBAC privileged set plus X distributed, Z chaos drill, O cluster submit, D doctor). X/Z/O/D are execution-fatal but NOT RBAC-privileged: they need no authorization, but their failure must not report success.

path.description: Log directory base (relative to the _Build root, resolved against ScriptRoot). Empty/absent falls back to BuildConstants LogsDir ('logs'). Supported by Orchestrator Initialize-BuildLogging.

maxLogAgeDays.description: Age ceiling in days for per-run build_*.log retention (Invoke-LogRetention). The file-count cap alone never removes an old-but-fewer-than-maxLogFiles file.

ports.description: Explicit port list checked by Test-PortAvailability; overrides the built-in default list

networkTimeout.description: Network connectivity probe timeout in SECONDS (converted to ms internally)

autoFixKillPorts.description: When true, AutoFix stops the process occupying a checked port (opt-in; default report-only)

failOnInvalidConfig.description: Abort build if config validation fails (requires Test-Json cmdlet)

blockOnCriticalVulns.description: Fail the build when critical vulnerabilities are found during security scan

extends.description: Name of another profile to inherit settings from (merged before this profile)

testProjectPatterns.description: Regex patterns identifying test projects excluded from auto-select (Project.psm1 Resolve-ProjectConfig).

systemDirPattern.description: Regex for system/underscore directories skipped in project discovery (Project.psm1 Resolve-ProjectConfig).

localeDir.description: Path to locale resource files (relative to Modules/ or absolute). Defaults to ../Locales

vendoredTools.description: Folder (relative to the _Build tree root) that holds the tooling this copy ships, e.g. the bundled PSScriptAnalyzer. Resolved by SharedUtils.Get-BuildVendoredToolsRoot and prepended to the session PSModulePath on demand, so a stale entry pointing at another copy cannot decide which analyzer a run gets.

additionalProperties.description: Extensible SDK properties — any valid JSON type is accepted for forward compatibility

releaseMetadataBaseUrl.description: Base URL for .NET release metadata (channel releases.json); used to learn the latest released SDK. Empty disables the remote check.

maxKnownSdkVersion.description: Offline fallback for the latest released SDK (e.g. 10.0.404); used when the release metadata is unreachable. Empty = unknown.

releaseCacheHours.description: How long a fetched latest-release version is trusted before re-checking (hours)

releaseCacheFileName.description: File name of the user-local latest-release cache (next to the SDK cache)

enabled.description: Auto-download SDK if not found (requires admin or writable installDir)

version.description: Exact SDK version to install (e.g. 10.0.300); wins over channel so a project global.json pin can be satisfied reproducibly. Empty = channel behaviour.

installerSha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the dotnet-install script; mismatch fails closed. Empty (default, compat) proceeds with a warning.

searchPaths.description: SDK search path groups for discovery waterfall

ghostDetection.description: Detect stub/fake SDK executables that are not real SDKs

ghostPatterns.description: Regex patterns that identify ghost executables

commitCount.description: Number of git commits included in generated changelog (New-Changelog).

defaultVersion.description: Fallback project version when no version file/manifest exists (BuildConstants.DefaultProjectVersion).

searchDepth.description: Directory recursion depth for version.json / csproj scan (Versioning.psm1).

vulnerabilityTimeoutSec.description: Per-invocation timeout in seconds for each vulnerable-package audit (npm audit, dotnet list --vulnerable, govulncheck, pip-audit, cargo audit). On timeout the audit is killed and the step degrades to Skipped instead of hanging the build. 0 disables the timeout. Distinct from security.sast.timeoutSec, which bounds the SAST scanners rather than the package audits. Read by Security.psm1 via Get-SecurityConfigValue -Path 'security.vulnerabilityTimeoutSec'.

vulnerabilityAllowlist.description: Per-advisory accepted-risk list. An entry exempts matching findings from blocking the build, but ONLY while two invariants hold: (1) `reason` holds a non-empty human-readable justification that also names a reviewer or owner; (2) `until` (ISO date YYYY-MM-DD) is in the future. EXPIRED entries stop being honored and the findings they covered fall back to blocking, so a stale entry fails the build rather than silently disappearing. gbuild writes every accepted decision to the audit ledger with advisory/package/reason/until so a security review can audit it. _Build does NOT guess patched versions or auto-bump deps - decisions about upgrading or accepting risk belong to the project; _Build only enforces transparency.

advisory.description: Advisory identifier, as reported by the scanner (e.g. 'GHSA-846f-f764-76mx' or 'CVE-2025-79xxx'). Must match an actual finding; otherwise the entry is reported stale.

package.description: Optional substring/scope applied to Vuln.Package. Present = requires the advisory to match on this package too; absent = any matching advisory anywhere.

severity.description: Optional scope to a single severity. Absent = any severity presenting that advisory.

reason.description: Non-empty justification (min 20 chars) naming WHY the risk is accepted and WHO owns the follow-up. Surfaced verbatim in the audit ledger entry.

until.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). While before today, the entry is active; once it lapses the covered vulns block again (and _Build prints a 'stale allowlist entry' notice). This is the time-box mechanism - a 1-year 'until' is not a long-term solution.

vulnerabilitySeverityThreshold.description: Blocking threshold: a finding whose severity rank meets or exceeds this blocks the build. 'none' disables blocking on severity (still logged to audit ledger). Replaces the old binary 'block/all' behaviour.

scanOnBuild.description: Run the security gate (secret scan, vulnerable-package audit, license compliance) as part of the standard build pipeline. Ships TRUE: a gate nobody runs is not a gate. Set false only for local exploratory builds - a failing scan then still fails the build with exit code 2.

reportCodeSigning.description: Report code-signing status (Signed / NotSigned) during the security scan. INFORMATIONAL ONLY - never fails the build. SmartScreen warns on unsigned binaries but they can still be distributed, so this is a status line, not a gate.

allowedActions.description: Allow-list of privileged menu actions (e.g. '13' for GitHub Actions). When present, only listed actions are permitted; empty = deny all privileged. Omitted = allow all (backward compatible).

policy.description: SBOM policy gate: allow/deny package lists evaluated against generated components

provenance.description: SLSA provenance attestation (in-toto statement) after build

artifactSign.description: Artifact signing via cosign sign-blob or notation. FAIL-CLOSED: when enabled and the signing CLI is absent the build is blocked (see SupplyChain.Tests.ps1 'P0 fail-closed regressions'). Disabled by default so a machine without a signing keypair is not blocked; enable it once cosign is installed and configured.

images.description: Container image refs for notation signing

peSign.description: Authenticode signing of the Windows PE artifacts (.exe/.dll) a build produced. This is the PE counterpart of security.artifactSign (which signs containers/OCI blobs with cosign and cannot sign a Windows binary). tool=signtool uses the Windows SDK signtool.exe with a local certificate; tool=external runs any command line that signs one file (placeholder {file} in externalArguments). The certificate password is read from the environment variable named by certificatePasswordEnv - never from this file. Disabled by default so an existing project keeps its exact behaviour; when enabled and the signing tool is missing the step is skipped with a clear message unless failOnError is true.

artifacts.description: File patterns of the artifacts to sign

certificatePath.description: Path to the .pfx certificate used by signtool/powershell

certificateThumbprint.description: Thumbprint of the certificate in the Windows certificate store, used by the powershell signer

certificatePasswordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the certificate password

timestampUrl.description: RFC 3161 timestamp server; empty disables timestamping

externalCommand.description: Command line that signs one artifact when tool=external

externalArguments.description: Argument template for tool=external; {file} is replaced with the artifact path

azureEndpoint.description: Artifact Signing endpoint (https://<region>.codesigning.azure.net). Together with azureAccount and azureProfile it makes the account DETECTED: the signer uses it as soon as the signtool and the Artifact Signing dlib are on the machine.

azureMetadataPath.description: Path to an existing metadata.json; empty means the tool looks for one and writes it from the three values above

azureSignToolPath.description: Path to signtool.exe; empty means the tool finds it on this machine

azureDlibPath.description: Path to Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll; empty means the tool finds it on this machine

verify.description: valid = the signature chain must be trusted (a CA certificate); signature = the file only has to carry a signature (self-signed certificate that the client machines trust); none = do not verify

autoProvisionSelfSigned.description: When no CA credential is configured, create (once) a machine self-signed code-signing certificate so the artifacts are still signed and shippable. A self-signed certificate cannot satisfy SmartScreen's reputation check - that needs a CA - but it keeps every project signed without a per-project setup.

release.description: Packages the build output into something you can sell: one archive, a .sha256 file the buyer verifies the download with, and a .json manifest (project, version, git commit, signed or not). The destination folder is configured ONCE per machine in the signing profile, so every project publishes itself without a per-project setup.

outputDir.description: Shared folder the release is copied to. Empty keeps the package in <projectRoot>\release. The machine profile overrides this.

excludePatterns.description: Extra regex patterns of files that must not ship

containerScan.description: Container/filesystem vulnerability scanning via trivy. FAIL-CLOSED: when enabled and the trivy CLI is absent the build is blocked, matching security.artifactSign - a gate you enabled must be able to give a verdict. Disabled by default so a machine without trivy is not blocked; enable it once the scanner is installed.

tool.description: Scanner CLI used for container/filesystem vulnerability scanning

sast.description: Multi-language static analysis (Sast.psm1): routes to language-specific scanners (dotnet list --vulnerable, npm audit, bandit, cargo-audit, gosec, cppcheck, brakeman, phpcs, Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer). Graceful-degrade when the scanner tool is missing.

tools.description: Optional per-language override map: { "<Language>": "<custom command>" }. Omitted languages fall back to the built-in tool map.

dotnetIgnoreNoFindingsExitCode.description: When true, 'dotnet list package --vulnerable' exit code 1 (no vulnerabilities found) is treated as success (BuildConstants.SastDotnetIgnoreNoFindingsExitCode).

timeoutSec.description: Per-tool SAST execution timeout in seconds. dotnet list --vulnerable can stall on NuGet restore; on timeout the tool is killed and the step degrades to Skipped instead of hanging the build. 0 disables the timeout (BuildConstants.SastTimeoutSec).

bundledAnalyzerVersion.description: PSScriptAnalyzer version this _Build copy bundles under paths.vendoredTools. SharedUtils.Resolve-VendoredToolModule imports it when Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer does not already resolve, so PowerShell SAST and lint run without the project installing anything (BuildConstants.ScriptAnalyzerVersion).

toolUnavailablePolicy.description: Behaviour when an optional SAST tool is not installed.

policy.description: Policy-as-code gate (Policy.psm1): evaluates OPA/Rego files under security.policy.dir (data.<package>.deny). Falls back to a built-in rule engine when OPA is not installed. Enforcement: warn (non-blocking) / block (fail build) / fail (throw).

dir.description: Directory containing .rego files (OPA). Empty = built-in rules only.

package.description: OPA Rego package name whose 'deny' set is evaluated

opaServerUrl.description: OPA server base URL for enterprise sidecar (e.g. http://opa:8181). Empty = disabled; supports ${env:VAR}. (BuildConstants.PolicyOpaServerUrl).

rules.description: Built-in rules when OPA/Rego unavailable: [{ rule, match, path, value, action(deny/allow), excludePaths[] }]. match = '*' (any path) or 'key=value' pattern. excludePaths = wildcard entry-keys the rule never applies to (e.g. the single-source constants file).

excludePaths.description: Wildcard entry-keys exempt from this rule (single-source-of-truth files that legitimately centralize literals).

allowExternalDir.description: When true, policy.dir may point outside the project root (centrally managed policy). Defaults to false (project-contained policy only).

siem.description: SIEM export (Siem.psm1): forwards security audit events to a SIEM aggregator. format: cef (ArcSight) / syslog (RFC5424) / json. transport: file (graceful-degrade) / udp / http.

endpoint.description: Syslog host or HTTP URL. Supports ${env:VAR} placeholders.

enterpriseId.description: Private enterprise number for [gbuild@<id> ...] structured data (RFC5424, BuildConstants.SiemEnterpriseId).

timeoutSec.description: HTTP transport timeout in seconds for SIEM export.

excludeDirs.description: Static directories excluded from secret scanning (build artifacts, VCS metadata). Test directories are auto-detected by containing *.Tests.ps1 files — do NOT list them here.

scanMaxFileMB.description: Skip files larger than this size (MB) during secret scanning.

scanDepth.description: Directory recursion depth for security scans (BuildConstants.SecurityScanDepth).

secretPatterns.description: Custom search patterns for secret scanning (used by Security.psm1). Merged with built-in patterns.

gpgSign.description: Enable GPG signing for deploy artifacts. Boolean shorthand or object { enabled, keyId }.

keyId.description: Optional GPG key id to sign with

artifactExtensions.description: GPG artifacts eligible for signing, dot-prefixed and lower-case. Cross-platform by default: Windows forms (.exe/.dll/.msi/.msix), archives (.zip/.nupkg/.jar/.war), native Unix libraries (.so/.dylib/.a), mobile bundles (.apk/.aab/.ipa/.pkg/.app) and (.wasm/.deb/.rpm). Debug output (.pdb/.xml/.map) is deliberately absent. This list is separate from build.clean.artifactExtensions because signing and cleaning are different questions; narrowing it is how you stop signing a whole platform by accident.

vaultKeyFile.description: Path to vault encryption key file, supports ${env:VAR}

vault.description: CredentialVault cryptographic parameters (CredentialVault.psm1). All support ${env:VAR} placeholders. Defaults come from BuildConstants (pbkdf2Iterations >= 100000 per NIST).

pbkdf2Iterations.description: PBKDF2 iterations for AES key derivation (>= 100000 recommended). Numeric string OK (env placeholder).

VaultStaticSalt.description: Static salt used when no salt is supplied to Get-DerivedKey. Supports ${env:VAR}.

VaultMachineSalt.description: Machine-scoped salt for the ephemeral fallback key. Supports ${env:VAR}.

allowLegacyCbc.description: Allow reading legacy (pre-v2) unauthenticated AES-CBC payloads. Must be explicitly opted in; default-disabled for crypto safety.

auditLogPath.description: Path for security audit log output

auditLogMaxSizeMB.description: Max audit log size before rotation (renames to audit-<timestamp>.log)

redactPatterns.description: Credential patterns redacted from logs by Remove-Credentials (config-driven, extensible).

encryptedValue.description: Prefix convention: config values produced by CredentialVault (Protect-CredentialValue / ConvertTo-EncryptedSecret) are prefixed with 'enc:'. At runtime Resolve-SecretValue transparently decrypts them via DPAPI (Windows). Values already encrypted this way are NOT flagged as plaintext secrets by the scanner.

rbac.description: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC.psm1): enterprise-grade authorization with roles, permissions, resource scoping, and policy-as-code integration.

enabled.description: Enable RBAC authorization (when false, falls back to security.allowedActions only)

enforcement.description: RBAC/policy fail-open vs fail-closed (RBAC.psm1 Get-RbacEnforcementMode): permissive skips missing engine with audit log; strict denies. Additive, defaults to permissive for compat.

enforceInCI.description: L5 CI deny-by-default: non-interactive runs deny privileged actions without an explicit allow-list or full RBAC. Read-only actions (ciReadOnlyActions) stay available.

ciReadOnlyActions.description: Menu actions still allowed in CI when enforceInCI is on and no allow-list is configured (diagnostics only).

defaultRole.description: Default role assigned to users without explicit mapping

privilegedActions.description: Single source of truth for the privileged menu-action set. Orchestrator gates on this list and Menu.psm1 greys out entries that security.allowedActions denies, so the UI never advertises a rejected choice.

roles.description: Custom role definitions (merges with built-in: Viewer, Developer, BuildEngineer, SecurityOfficer, ReleaseManager, PlatformAdmin, Auditor)

resources.description: Custom resource hierarchy (merges with built-in: build, test, deploy, cache, security, report, log, metric, artifact, version, release, promote, audit, trail, scan, policy, vuln, sbom, provenance, secret)

tenantRoles.description: Per-tenant role overrides applied over the built-in RBAC role table (RBAC.psm1). Omitted = no tenant-specific roles.

trustEnvironmentRoles.description: When true, role names listed in trustedEnvRoles are honoured from the process environment. Fail-closed default.

trustedEnvRoles.description: Role names accepted from the process environment when trustEnvironmentRoles is true. Empty = deny all.

auditLedger.description: Immutable audit trail with WORM/ledger support (AuditLedger.psm1): hash-chained entries, Merkle tree checkpoints, cryptographic signing, compliance export.

memoryCap.description: Max entries retained in the in-memory ring used by the 'ledger' backend

path.description: Ledger file path (relative to project root)

objectLock.description: Enable S3 Object Lock for WORM

retentionDays.description: Retention period in days (7 years default)

signingKey.description: Path to signing private key (env placeholder supported)

requireKey.description: L5 fail-closed: signing enabled without a usable key throws at init. Set signing.enabled=false to explicitly accept an unsigned ledger.

keyPath.description: Path to private key (env placeholder supported)

schedule.description: Cron schedule for verification (daily 2 AM default)

vulnerabilityToolPolicy.description: How a missing optional vulnerability scanner is handled.

bindAddress.description: Bind address: 'localhost' (secure, no admin needed) or '+' (all interfaces, requires URL reservation)

altPorts.description: Fallback ports tried when the primary port cannot be bound

enabled.description: Chạy InfraVerification trong pipeline build. Switch -VerifyInfra chạy độc lập (không cần bật).

remoteCache.description: Kiểm tra cấu hình remote cache (read-only)

otel.description: Probe collector OTLP bằng 1 counter tối thiểu

webhook.description: Kiểm tra alerting.webhookUrl đã cấu hình hợp lệ

webhookSendTest.description: Gửi test alert thật tới webhook (thận trọng)

sdk.description: Xác minh dotnet --list-sdks (phát hiện ghost stub)

outputDir.description: Thư mục báo cáo (tương đối từ ProjectRoot)

android.description: Android debug keystore + default ApplicationId defaults (single source, config-overridable).

defaultApplicationId.description: Fallback ApplicationId used when a project does not declare <ApplicationId>.

adbUninstallDelayMs.description: Delay (ms) after adb uninstall before install.

adbAutoConnectEndpoints.description: ADB endpoints (host:port) to auto-connect when no device is detected. Covers emulators, physical devices reachable over TCP/IP, and cross-OS bridges.

alias.description: Keystore alias for the generated debug key.

additionalProperties.description: Extensible deploy properties — any valid JSON type is accepted for forward compatibility

webReadinessAttempts.description: Polling attempts (WebAppLaunchDelayMs apart) waiting for a launched web app to listen on its port.

webAppLaunchDelayMs.description: Base probe interval (ms) between readiness polls, growing adaptively up to a cap.

webAppLaunchDelayMinMs.description: Minimum probe interval (ms) during the fast port-listen phase of readiness detection.

webPortProbe.description: When true, probe for TCP port-listen first (fast) before confirming an HTTP response, then wait for HTTP serving.

webAppLaunchMaxAttempts.description: Total web-apphost launch attempts (first try plus fresh-process retries) before reporting not-ready. A transient slow start is retried with a new process rather than failing immediately.

requiredFields.description: Override required-field maps per deploy target (key=target name, value=array of required property names).

environments.description: Named deployment environments with branch mapping and approval rules

branch.description: Git branch pattern for this environment

distributionId.description: CloudFront distribution id (can use env var)

statePath.description: Optional explicit path for breaker state file

overrides.description: Per-tenant config overlay: deep-merges tenancy.overrides.<tenantId> over the effective config at pipeline bootstrap

apply.description: Run the after-build remediation action (e.g. CHANGELOG generation) even when the hook was invoked without -Apply. Default false keeps post-build runs read-only.

provider.description: Webhook payload format. 'generic' sends a gbuild JSON envelope; 'slack'/'teams'/'discord' format natively and auto-detects from webhookUrl when set to generic.

rotateTokens.description: Enable time-based webhook token rotation; rotated token is sent in the X-Gbuild-Token header.

tokenByteLength.description: Byte length of generated webhook tokens (BuildConstants.WebhookTokenByteLength).

distributed.description: Multi-host distributed build execution via SSH (cross-platform, PS 5.1 safe). Remote hosts must already have the repository cloned and build SDKs installed — no file sync is performed.

enabled.description: Enable distributed build execution across remote hosts

strategy.description: Task distribution strategy: round-robin cycles hosts, tag-based matches task tags to host tags then falls back to round-robin

sshPort.description: Default SSH port for distributed hosts (BuildConstants.SshDefaultPort).

repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root on each remote host (assumes repo already cloned)

strictHostKeyChecking.description: SSH StrictHostKeyChecking value: 'accept-new' (secure), 'no' (insecure, legacy), or 'yes' (strict). Defaults to 'accept-new' for first-use trust.

hosts.description: List of remote build agent hosts

hostname.description: IP or DNS name of the host

identityFile.description: Path to SSH private key, supports ~ expansion

tags.description: Labels used for tag-based task affinity

maxConcurrent.description: Max parallel tasks on this host

certificateThumbprint.description: A2: X.509 thumbprint in Windows/macOS cert store; supports ${env:VAR} placeholder (resolved at runtime); validated as pre-flight

certificatePath.description: A2: path to PEM certificate file (e.g. Linux); validated as pre-flight

requireCert.description: A2 hard-gate: when true and the host declares a certificate, an invalid certificate EXCLUDES the host from the build pool

minConcurrent.description: Minimum concurrent tasks for distributed build (BuildConstants.DistributedMinConcurrent).

maxTotalConcurrency.description: Global runspace-pool ceiling for distributed dispatch (backpressure for 10+ hosts, BuildConstants.DistributedMaxTotalConcurrency).

probeBatchSize.description: SSH probe batch size for large fleets (BuildConstants.DistributedProbeBatchSize).

taskMaxRetries.description: Per-task retry for transient SSH failures (BuildConstants.DistributedTaskMaxRetries).

reportPath.description: Directory (under ScriptRoot) for the distributed build result aggregation dashboard, JSON + Markdown (BuildConstants.DistributedReportPath).

id.description: Builder identifier URI for SLSA provenance

type.description: Build type URI for SLSA provenance

supplyChain.description: Supply-chain tooling identity (SupplyChain.psm1). Config-overridable tool name for attestation/signing.

toolName.description: Tool name stamped in SBOM/provenance metadata (BuildConstants.SupplyChainToolName).

rootCause.description: Auto root-cause analysis for build failures (RootCause.psm1). Pattern-based diagnosis with confidence-scored suggestions and history persistence.

autoTune.description: Self-optimizing build performance (AutoTuner.psm1). Analyzes historical build metrics and suggests/applies configuration optimizations for parallelism, cache, and timeouts. Opt-in; never mutates safety margins without explicit autoApply=true.

autoApply.description: When true, recommendations are applied to State.BuildConfig automatically. When false, they are only logged.

verifyEnabled.description: Verify tuned values against guardrails before apply (BuildConstants.AutoTuneVerifyEnabled).

ewmaAlpha.description: EWMA smoothing factor for the duration regressor (BuildConstants.AutoTuneEwmaAlpha).

cacheHitRateLow.description: Hit-rate below which cache size grows (BuildConstants.AutoTuneCacheHitRateLow).

cacheHitRateHigh.description: Hit-rate at/above which cache size stays at default (BuildConstants.AutoTuneCacheHitRateHigh).

chaos.description: Chaos/resilience testing (Chaos.psm1). Injects controlled failures to validate retry, rollback, circuit breaker, and graceful degradation. Never enabled in production by default.

anomaly.description: Statistical anomaly detection on build metrics (AnomalyDetector.psm1). Uses z-score, EWMA, and trend analysis on the AutoTuner history to surface performance regressions and stability issues before they block the pipeline.

zScoreThreshold.description: Z-score above which a build metric is treated as anomalous.

ewmaAlpha.description: Smoothing factor for EWMA trend detection (higher = more reactive).

minSamples.description: Minimum history samples before anomaly detection activates.

alertOnAnomaly.description: When true, anomalous builds emit an alert via Alerting.psm1 in addition to the log line.

ewmaMultiplier.description: EWMA exceed multiplier for drift detection (BuildConstants.AnomalyEwmaMultiplier).

failureRateHighZScore2.description: High threshold (second tier) for failure-rate anomalies (BuildConstants.AnomalyFailureRateHighZScore2).

stepTimeoutSeconds.description: Step watchdog in seconds for the pipeline step SLA (0 = disabled, the default). When enabled, a step whose wall-clock exceeds this is failed AFTER it returns - it cannot rescue a hung step (use per-step job:true for preemptive kill) and it fails already-succeeded slow steps, so leave 0 unless you need an explicit SLA.

driftMinDeltaSeconds.description: Absolute floor in seconds: histogram (timing) series must clear it as well as the percentage before drift is reported

alertOnImprovement.description: When false (default), a faster-than-baseline timing is not reported as drift; only regressions alert. Set true to restore symmetric alerting.

historySize.description: Rolling window for the median baseline: comparisons run against the median of the last N persisted runs instead of the single most recent run

excludedSteps.description: Pipeline step names excluded from drift comparison (high-variance infrastructure steps whose timing is not a product signal)
